result:
The no-all-caps rule is already enforced across the game, and this run retargeted the old checks that still asserted caps text. No new game change was needed, so nothing was shipped.

- **How it's enforced:** earlier runs shipped v29.11 and v29.14. All canvas text and all page text pass through one function (`ncFix`), and the CSS removes `text-transform:uppercase`. Real acronyms are kept, such as SP, XP, HP, LMG, SMG, DMR, KIA, HUD and FPS. That list also keeps a few I didn't see in your list: PVP, PVE, WASD, LMB, RMB, TNT, UFO and USB.
- **Old checks:** about 35 old checks failed because they matched caps text. I made them case-blind and committed that in 466534b6 and b1dd8871. After rebuilding the fixture, they all pass except the ones below.
- **Source scan:** I found no caps in CSS `content`, `alert`, `confirm` or `prompt`, `OffscreenCanvas`, `textTransform`, SVG text, or option text. I didn't run a whole-game scan of the text actually shown on screen. Checks 29.11 and 29.14 both pass.
- **Still failing, and not about caps:**
  - 26.52 and 26.37 fail on the v29.15 gun key renumbering (Digit0, key 8).
  - 22.95 skips because the compass line wasn't drawn.
  - 10.41 fails because the pause box controls line didn't show "E interact" or "CTRL / C crouch toggle" when the check read it. I didn't find the cause.

The notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/00-no-all-caps.md`.

TASK DONE
